Finally, on the conservative end, setting up and funding the Solo 401(k) and using standard depreciation on any gear purchases will be clearly supported, offering the lowest risk but at the expense of upfront tax savings.

Finally, I need to include a note on the key dependencies, making it clear that I'm not assuming anything. The viability and classification of these assertive strategies, absolutely depends on the CPA's verification of market rates, business-only equipment usage, and confirmation that the delayed invoices are legitimately deferred income. The key is to make everything conditional and clear. I think this will be a good product.
